title: Benchmarking transcriptomic immune signatures for ICI response: analysis code and derived results
description:
Analysis code and derived results for the manuscript Expression-level immune signatures outperform gene-set enrichment scores for predicting immune checkpoint inhibitor response: a cross-cohort benchmark in 591 patients.

The repository benchmarks 27 strategies for constructing a transcriptomic immune score under one fixed scoring, discrimination and pooling procedure across six independent ICI-treated cohorts (591 patients, 127 responders), with TCGA-HNSC (520 primary tumours, 221 death events) as the discovery cohort. Scores built from gene-level expression consistently outperformed scores built from gene-set enrichment statistics (pooled AUC 0.519-0.668 versus 0.525-0.557).

No new data were generated; all inputs are public (TCGA-HNSC via the UCSC Xena / GDC hub, GEO GSE159067 / GSE176307 / GSE91061 / GSE78220 / GSE135222, and IMvigor210 via IMvigor210CoreBiologies). Raw data are not redistributed; a download script retrieves every input from its original archive. Two scripts were re-run and reproduced their shipped outputs byte-for-byte.

Code is released under the MIT licence; derived results under CC BY 4.0. Original source data remain subject to the terms of their original archives.
